claim: Identity Health & Shadow (Human Operating Layer, Layer 3) — FREEZE-SAFE identity observability over the Identity Sandbox (anima/identity_sandbox). A read-only health surface (anima/identity_health/health.py): the identity-core summary (which of dials/persona/values/portrait/narrative are present — a field-presence summary, never the raw content), the tamper-evident SHADOW LEDGER (a hash-chained snapshot ledger whose integrity is verified — ledger_verify proves versions strictly increase, each recorded state_hash matches a recompute, and each parent_hash chains to the prior), the latest identity DIFF (which core field changed between two snapshots), and the FREEZE posture. THE KEYSTONE: identity MUTATION stays frozen — the only instrument that writes identity (rollback) is wrapped in the sandbox's FrozenIdentityError seatbelt, so pointed at REAL Vera while the freeze holds it raises before a byte is written; this layer can only OBSERVE. Health flags (stable / observed / ledger_intact / freeze_respected) are computed from real state. Served + auth-gated: GET /identity serves the page shell, GET /identity.json rides behind the Face ID seam. Read-only; observe now, change later — only when the founder lifts the freeze (2026-07-03).
owner: anima/identity_health/ (health.py report — read-only aggregation), anima/identity_sandbox.py (the freeze-safe sandbox: read_identity_state / ledger_verify / diff / rollback guard — unchanged), anima/server.py (_identity_health_data + GET /identity + GET /identity.json), anima/web/identity.html (identityView: freeze banner + health flags + identity-core summary + Shadow Ledger integrity + diff), scripts/certify_identity_health.py

killer_test.name: freeze_safe_identity_observability_mutation_stays_frozen
killer_test.setup: scripts/certify_identity_health.py proves the health report reads the identity core as a field-presence summary (not raw content) with honest health flags; the Shadow Ledger is a tamper-evident hash chain (a well-formed ledger verifies) and DETECTS tampering (altering a recorded snapshot flips verify to not-ok with a break); the identity diff reports exactly which core field changed; the KEYSTONE — rollback() pointed at REAL Vera raises FrozenIdentityError (mutation is frozen); building the report is read-only (identity fingerprint unchanged); and the report rides through _identity_health_data + GET /identity with the dashboard page.
killer_test.prompt: open /identity — Vera's identity core, its tamper-evident Shadow Ledger, and a frozen badge proving her identity cannot be mutated while the freeze holds

known_gaps: First cut: freeze-safe OBSERVABILITY — the identity-core summary, the tamper-evident Shadow Ledger, the diff viewer, and the proven freeze. Identity MUTATION (rollback / restore / drift remediation) stays frozen by design until 2026-07-03; the rollback capability is built + tested but INERT for real Vera (it raises FrozenIdentityError). When the founder lifts the freeze, the Shadow Ledger + diff + rollback become the safe path to change identity with proof and reversal. Per-turn identity-drift alerting on top of this health surface is the next enrichment.
